- Tue May 12: 9:30–11:30am or 3:00–4:30pm
- Wed May 13: 10:00–12:00pm

If none of these work, I can send a Calendly link to let you pick a time. I'll include Markus (AE) and Camila (onboarding) to ensure we have the right folks on the call.
